title.narrative: Resilient, Open and Accountable Democracies for the Eastern Partnership (Road4EaP)

description.narrative:
The action will be implemented by the Open Government Partnership Europe and is complimentary to the project, Strengthening the fight against corruption in EU Eastern Partnership Countries project, also established under EU4Intergity II and implemented by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development.

The action is designed to strengthen democracy and improve citizens' lives in Eastern Partnership (EaP) countries through the preparation and implementation of an action plan to improve open, inclusive and accountable governments, able to resist corruption. The intended impact of the Action is reduced corruption and more open and inclusive governments in the EaP countries.

The main expected outcome of this Action is the mainstreaming and implementation of open government and anti-corruption approaches in EaP countries. To support the completion of this outcome, OGP will engage a broader range of government and civil society actors, strengthen the reformers, enhance partnerships with international partners and multilateral institutions, and provide assistance in the co-creation and collaboration on the open government and anti-corruption reforms in an inclusive manner.

The proposed activities include supporting the design and implementation of OGP action plans; issuing civil society sub-grants; facilitating the participation of stakeholders in OGP and partner events; convening regional and thematic peer exchanges; providing leadership development and skill-building trainings; publishing evidence-based recommendations; and recognising successful reforms through the Open Government Challenge and open government awards - all to advancing the uptake and realisation of impactful anti-corruption and open government reforms. ¿

The target groups and beneficiaries of this Action include government officials, civil society organisations, journalists, citizens and private sector organisations of EaP countries. ¿

Through the implementation of this Action, EaP countries will make progress in anti-corruption and open government reforms, enhance collaboration between government and civil society, and create a culture of transparency, accountability, and citizen participation, which will ultimately lead to stronger democracies and better governance in the region.
